title: OmniSpec spec fit answers
description: Declared answers that select the ceremony route. Structural validation does not prove the answers are true; the route is derived from them, never written by hand.

reasoning.description: Recorded reasoning before drafting. The answer is a declaration, not proof of understanding.

files.description: Estimated affected files. Routing thresholds are project heuristics, not experimentally universal limits.

modules.description: Estimated affected modules or packages requiring coordination.

crossesContract.description: Whether a public API, data schema, storage format or other dependency contract changes.

ambiguity.description: Remaining ambiguity in the request after inspection and clarification.

existingTests.description: Whether automated tests already cover the area being changed.

risk.description: Version 2 assessed consequence; high or critical escalates even a one-file change.

uncertainty.description: Version 2 remaining technical or product uncertainty.

reversibility.description: Version 2 ability to recover without irreversible data loss or external effects.
